content.text: {"incident_detected":false,"root_cause_hypothesis":"The anomaly-week approval rate was low, but the data does not establish that an iOS app release caused it: no iOS release is listed during that week, and the rate was close to the lowest observed in the preceding 12 weeks.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"iOS driving-licence KYC approval rate","baseline_value":0.886076,"anomaly_value":0.804598,"unit":"fraction","sql":"DuckDB query returned prior_week_approval_rate and anomaly_week_approval_rate from agg_kyc_daily for iOS driving licences: prior week starting 2026-04-06 versus anomaly week starting 2026-04-13."},{"name":"iOS driving-licence KYC decisions","baseline_value":79,"anomaly_value":87,"unit":"count","sql":"Same DuckDB query returned prior_week_decisions and anomaly_week_decisions from agg_kyc_daily."},{"name":"Prior 12-week iOS driving-licence approval rate: mean","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":0.876831,"unit":"fraction","sql":"Same DuckDB query calculated AVG(approval_rate) over the 12 weekly rates from 2026-01-19 through 2026-04-12."},{"name":"Prior 12-week iOS driving-licence approval rate: standard deviation","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":0.0329,"unit":"fraction","sql":"Same DuckDB query calculated STDDEV_SAMP(approval_rate) over the 12 weekly rates from 2026-01-19 through 2026-04-12."},{"name":"Prior 12-week iOS driving-licence approval rate: minimum","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":0.813725,"unit":"fraction","sql":"Same DuckDB query calculated MIN(approval_rate) over the 12 weekly rates from 2026-01-19 through 2026-04-12."},{"name":"iOS release during anomaly week","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":null,"unit":"date/version","sql":"Same DuckDB query checked stg_app_releases for iOS releases dated 2026-04-13 through 2026-04-19; returned null for release date and version."},{"name":"Latest iOS release before comparison weeks","baseline_value":8.9,"anomaly_value":null,"unit":"version","sql":"Same DuckDB query returned the latest iOS version before 2026-04-13 as version 8.9, released 2026-04-05."}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Approval was 0.886076 in the prior week (79 decisions) and 0.804598 in the anomaly week (87 decisions), versus a prior-12-week mean of 0.876831 and standard deviation of 0.0329.
